title: List page has a '← Lists' back link under a marked Lists tab; session pages have no back link
what_happens: The admin bar already shows Lists as the current tab, and the page adds a '← Lists' link right under it. A session's page (SessionHeader) has no back link: the Sessions tab is the way back. Same job done two ways.
who_hurts: An admin moving between a session and a list: two ways back on one page, a different way on the other.
suggested_fix: Drop the '← Lists' link from the list header (src/app/admin/lists/[id]/page.tsx header) so the Lists tab is the one way back, as on session pages. Keep the link on the not-found card, where it is the only action.
rule: Dane's UI rule: 'Be careful about redundant titles, headings and nav entries. Consolidate where possible.' Established pattern: SessionHeader has no back link.
